blogs.title: If you are writing Lakeflow Pipelines in Databricks, it’s time to update your imports.
blogs.summary: Databricks is phasing out legacy @dlt decorators in favor of Apache Spark Declarative Pipelines (SDP) using pyspark.pipelines (dp). Here is what the shift looks like and why it matters.

blogs.title: Optimizing Azure Databricks Cluster Costs in Telecom Delta Lake
blogs.summary: Key strategies for auto-scaling, spot instances, and Delta Lake Z-Ordering to drastically reduce compute costs on multi-terabyte workloads.
